1) Tue Nov 3, 09:00 IST / 04:30 JST / 23:30 PDT (Mon) — after Diwali, same week and avoids DST switch confusion.
2) Wed Nov 4, 08:30 IST / 05:00 JST / 00:00 PDT — slightly earlier for APAC but still workable.

If you confirm Nov 3/Nov 4 I will send a calendar invite with materials attached. Otherwise we can keep Oct 30 and I'll make sure recordings are captured and we add an async run-through for anyone OOO.
